مُغِدٌّ A camel having the disease termed غُدَّةٌ; (As, Az, S, O, L, K;) as also ↓ مُغَدٌّ (L) and ↓ مَغْدُودٌ , (Az, L, K,) or this is not said, (As, O, K,) but it was heard by Az from the Arabs, (O, L,) and ↓ مُغَدَّدٌ (Az, L) and ↓ غَادٌّ : (O, L, K:) مُغِدٌّ, without ة, is also applied to a she-camel: and its pl. is مَغَادُّ: (L:) the pl. of ↓ غَادٌّ is غِدَاذٌ. (O, L, K. *) ―
-b2- [Hence,] (tropical:) An angry man: (As, S, L:) or swollen by reason of anger, (A, L,) as though he were a camel having the disease termed غُدَّة. (A.) One says, رَأَيْتُ فُلَانًا مُغِدًّا and ↓ مُسْمَغِدًّا (tropical:) I saw such a one swollen with anger. (L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
